status.queued: Queued. This starts within a few seconds.
status.running: Writing you a lesson. This usually takes a few minutes — you can leave this page.
status.succeeded: {count, plural, =0 {Done.} one {Done — one new lesson.} other {Done — # new lessons.}}
status.succeeded_with_conflicts: Done, but somebody else had edited {count, plural, one {a file} other {# files}} while this was running. Both versions were kept.

conflict.heading: Where the other versions are
conflict.body: Nothing was overwritten. The incoming copy sits beside the original in your workspace, and you can decide which to keep.

warning.heading: {count, plural, one {# thing wasn't indexed} other {# things weren't indexed}}
warning.body: The files are saved. Some of what's in them didn't fit anything Mindforge tracks, so it isn't searchable yet.
warning.section_missing: A section this format expects is missing: {heading}
warning.section_placeholder: This section still has its template text: {heading}
warning.section_unknown: Nothing here stores this section yet: {heading}
warning.heading_duplicated: This heading appears twice; the first was used: {heading}
warning.value_unknown: Couldn't read {field}, so it was left blank.
warning.value_coerced: {field} wasn't one of the values Mindforge knows, so it was stored as the closest match.
warning.filename_unnumbered: {filename} has no number, so it isn't in the library. Files are named 0001-, 0002- and so on.
warning.filename_slug_normalized: The name of {filename} was simplified for the web.
warning.sequence_mismatch: Two files both claim number {seq}. {kept} was used.
warning.title_missing: No title, so one was taken from the {source}.
warning.title_ambiguous: This document has {count} top-level headings; the first was used as the title.

error.run_already_active: This mission is already being taught. Watch that run, or wait for it to finish.
